title: Pan-Fried Gnocchi with Italian Seasoning
description: A simple Chinese-inspired dish featuring pan-fried gnocchi with Italian seasoning and a hint of airy texture.

ingredients.name: Herring Fillets (optional)
ingredients.notes: For a pescatarian version, add diced herring fillets to the gnocchi

instructions: 1. Heat the airy olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
3. Add the gnocchi and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown.
4. Sprinkle Italian seasoning and salt over the gnocchi, and toss to combine.
5. If using herring fillets, add them to the gnocchi and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
